test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

We looked for

P. strong relationships at locations in the

Q. genome that are not well studied in

R. apple and looked for which compounds we

S. could identify and which had nutritional value
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. "PQRS." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence P is the first sentence as the paragraph begins with **'We looked for'.** The **preposition 'for' will be followed by a noun or pronoun** and among the given options the perfect fit is **'strong relationships.' **It provides the context for the research that was done, which was to identify strong relationships at specific locations in the genome.
 
• Sentence Q is the second sentence as it begins with the **noun 'gnome'** and clarifies that these specific locations which have strong relationships in the genome were not well studied in apples. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 4.
 
• Sentence R is the third sentence as it begins with the noun **'apple'**** **as the previous sentence ended with the **preposition 'in.' **It explains the purpose of the research was to find some compounds in the genomes of apples.
 
• Sentence S is the last sentence and describes the objective of the research, which was to identify compounds that had nutritional value. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

The correct order is:__ 

We looked for

**P.** strong relationships at locations in the

**Q. **genome that are not well studied in

**R.** apple and looked for which compounds we

**S. **could identify and which had nutritional value
